defects.justification: multer.memoryStorage buffers each upload, up to 50 MiB by default, fully in RAM before writing it to disk, and nothing limits concurrent uploads. A few dozen parallel uploads exhaust process memory. Disk/stream storage is the fix.
multer 1.4.5-lts.1 (range ^1.4.5-lts.1 stays on 1.x) has known DoS advisories (CVE-2025-47935 stream/memory leak, CVE-2025-47944 crash on malformed multipart) that were fixed only in multer 2.x.

Any client can delete any stored file, and upload or download too, because no authentication or ownership exists. The README only says to put a gateway in front. I would block on at least protecting the destructive DELETE route.

The bare catch maps every sharp/IO failure (thumbnail dir missing, disk full, permission error) to 415 'not a supported image' and drops the real error, so operational failures look like client errors and are never logged.
Dependency uses a caret range, so installs float to new minor/patch releases; with no lockfile in the app, builds are not reproducible and a compromised or broken release is pulled in automatically.
